title: Lead Me to Calvary
lyrics_original: King of my life I crown Thee now --
Lest I forget Thy thorn crowned brow,
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
Show me the tomb where Thou wast laid,
Angels in robes of light arrayed
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
Let me like Mary, thru the gloom,
Come with a gift to Thee;
Show to me now the empty tomb --
Lest I forget Thy love for me,
May I be willing, Lord, to bear
Even Thy cup of grief to share --
Thou hast borne all for me.
Lest I forget Thy love for me,

bible_verses.english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
He went forward a little, and fell on his face, praying, and saying, "My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me. Nevertheless, not as I desire, but as you desire."
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I crown You as the King of my life today. Forgive me for the moments I forget the weight of Your sacrifice and the depth of Your love shown at Calvary. Lead my heart back to Gethsemane and the cross whenever I begin to stray. Fill me with deep gratitude for Your grace, and help me live every day in the light of Your love. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In the busyness of daily life, our hearts can easily grow numb to the staggering depth of Christ's sacrifice. "Lead Me to Calvary" is a gentle prayer asking God to keep the cross at the very center of our vision. When we remember His thorn-crowned brow and the sorrow of Gethsemane, we are reminded of a love that surrendered everything for us. May this song draw you close to the Savior today, crowning Him as King of your heart once again.
